items.definition:
a formal statement testifying to someone's character or qualifications
The company uses customer testimonials to promote its products.

a period of three months
The first trimester of pregnancy is often the most challenging.

an area of high or hilly land
The sheep graze on the green uplands during the summer.

a piece of narration in a movie or broadcast, not accompanied by an image of the speaker
The documentary featured a famous actor doing the voiceover.

a device or person that analyzes
The gas analyzer detected a leak.

a substance that induces insensitivity to pain
The dentist gave me a local anesthetic.

the projecting edge of a hat or the very top edge of a container
The cup was filled to the brim with coffee.

decorative handwriting or handwritten lettering
She practices calligraphy as a hobby.

a large metal pot for cooking over an open fire
The witches stirred their potion in a large cauldron.

a wooden house or cottage with overhanging eaves, typically found in the Alps
We rented a cozy chalet for our ski trip.

the disposal of a dead person's body by burning it to ashes
The family chose cremation over burial.

a doctor who specializes in skin conditions
She made an appointment with a dermatologist for her rash.

the action of causing a bomb or explosive device to explode
The controlled detonation of the old building was scheduled for noon.

a semiconductor device allowing current flow in one direction
A diode is used to convert AC current to DC current.

something that makes you feel unhappy or depressed
The news about the job cuts was a real downer.

strong criticism; anti-aircraft fire
The politician received a lot of flak for his controversial remarks.

a person who is very interested in food
As a true foodie, she always knows the best restaurants in town.

lack of good sense or judgment
His foolishness led him to make a very bad decision.

a mass of fine, light hairs or fibers
There was a layer of dust and fuzz under the bed.

a type of antelope
A herd of impala grazed peacefully on the savanna.

the state of being impure; a substance that makes something impure
The water filter removes impurities from the tap water.

a joke or witty remark
His jest brought laughter to the room.

a wild cat with short tail and tufted ears
The lynx is known for its keen eyesight.

a principal route or system
The train runs on the mainline.

a chief support or prop
She has been the mainstay of the team for years.

a lack of trust
There was a deep mistrust between the two parties.

the point of a pen
The pen's nib was bent, making it difficult to write.

a member of a particular church parish
The priest greeted each parishioner after the service.

an area of land consisting of parks or open spaces
The city council voted to preserve the parkland for public use.

blasphemous or obscene language
The movie was criticized for its excessive use of profanity.

a person or thing that closely resembles another
He's a dead ringer for his father.

the introduction of a new product or service
The company announced the rollout of its new smartphone next month.

a substance that raises levels of physiological or nervous activity in the body.
Coffee is a common stimulant that helps people stay awake.

a memorable phrase or slogan, especially one used in advertising or associated with a famous person or thing.
The company's new tagline is very catchy.

a strong-smelling underground fungus, considered a culinary delicacy; a soft candy made of chocolate, cocoa, and cream.
The chef garnished the dish with fresh black truffle.

injury to the neck caused by a sudden, forceful jolt
She suffered whiplash in the car accident.

a member of a Japanese organized crime syndicate
The film depicted the brutal world of the Yakuza.

an area of land, typically measured in acres
The farm covers a vast acreage of land.

a person or animal with a congenital absence of pigment in the skin and hair (which are white) and the eyes (which are typically pink)
The albino rabbit had striking red eyes.

money that is owed and should have been paid earlier
He was several months in arrears with his rent.

a small, venomous snake of North Africa and Europe
Cleopatra is said to have died from the bite of an asp.

a symbol (*) used to mark text or indicate a footnote
An asterisk often indicates a note at the bottom of the page.

a flowering shrub of the rhododendron family
The garden was vibrant with blooming azaleas.

body (informal)
He's got a really fit bod from all his training.

a sudden large amount of something good
The discovery of gold led to a mining bonanza in the region.

a woman's chest; the emotional center
She held the secret close to her bosom.

a person who eats human flesh
The explorers were warned about the possibility of encountering cannibals.

a Roman army officer
The centurion led his legion into battle.

a feeling of uncritical satisfaction with oneself or one's achievements
His complacency led to him underestimating the challenge.

a state of happiness and satisfaction
He found contentment in his simple life.

a medieval weapon consisting of a bow fixed across a wooden stock
The hunter used a crossbow to shoot the target.

a severe flood; an overwhelming quantity of something
The town was hit by a deluge of rain.

a title of various Muslim rulers, especially in the Middle East
The emir ruled his territory with absolute authority.

a pitch thrown at high speed in baseball
The pitcher threw a ninety-mile-per-hour fastball.

the action or process of fertilizing an egg, female animal, or plant, involving the fusion of male and female gametes to form a zygote
Pollination is necessary for the fertilization of many plants.

a plant of the linen family, cultivated for its oil-rich seeds and for its fibers, which are used to make linen
Linen fabric is made from the fibers of the flax plant.

a hindrance or obstruction
His stutter was an impediment to his public speaking career.

the act of bringing goods into a country
The importation of foreign cars has increased significantly.

a person who kidnaps someone
The police arrested the kidnapper after a long chase.

a substance used to reduce friction
Oil is used as a lubricant in engines.

a tendency to consider material possessions and physical comfort as more important than spiritual values
He criticized modern society for its excessive materialism.

one's native country
He felt a deep longing for his motherland.

the state of being too crowded
Overcrowding in cities leads to various social problems.

microscopic organisms floating in water
Whales feed on tiny plankton in the ocean.
